behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError, RelativeConnector.Write) decides only the status of a relative WRITE whose key is outside the file, 24 at 2002 (§2002:14.8.47.3 GR29b); this rule governs the GLOBAL clause on a containing program's FD and never meets it. The switch's 2002 arm itself holds: pb5125_relative_write_key_range_pre2014 run at --std 2002 this session MATCHes its .out (ABOVE=24 INVALID HIGH, ZERO=24 INVALID ZERO).
